title: Cyclic normalization of constant-extension restriction
statement: For the equivalence e supplied by lem-zl-constant-extension-weil-heart-equivalence, let R be constantExtensionRestriction D m hm X₀ l hl Ω e. If R satisfies ConstantExtensionRestrictionSpec, then the composite G = R ⋙ e.inverse admits the componentwise cyclic normalization: every sheet pullback of G is naturally isomorphic to R, the successor equations hold for adjacent Fin m coordinates, and the return equation is the normalized m-fold Weil iterate.

source.place: Paragraph after (1.1.10), p.152; cyclic sheet normalization and return comparison.

proof.text: Choose an auxiliary sheet-return equivalence T with SheetSpec. Whisker its carrier comparison with actual inverse image and compose with the inverse sheet/projection compositor. The equation pullbackSheetReturnComparison turns its SheetSpec structure equation into RestrictionSpec for actual inverse image followed by T. Two functors with RestrictionSpec are naturally isomorphic: compose their carrier comparisons, use their two structure equations to verify the Weil square, and lift this carrier isomorphism to the full Weil-heart subcategories.

For the arbitrary e in the statement, cancel e.functor with e.inverse by its unit to obtain U:G isomorphic to actual inverse image. Applying T and the preceding isomorphism gives c:G followed by T isomorphic to R. Compose the inverse of the SheetSpec carrier comparison with c on carriers to obtain b from distinguished-sheet pullback of G to the carrier of R. The SheetSpec structure equation and the Weil square of c prove the required return equation for b. Whisker with the zeroth-coordinate identification to obtain gamma_0; its inverse cancels in the return equation.

The actual Weil structure is a natural isomorphism from Frobenius applied to the carrier functor to that carrier functor. Whisker it with the ith sheet pullback and precede it by the canonical successor equality and normalized compositor. This gives the natural isomorphism whose components are exactly constantExtensionCoordinateStep. Define gamma_(i+1) as this step followed by gamma_i. Induction on the natural index, with the bound i<m, gives all coordinates and the successor equations by the defining recursion. At m=1 there are no successors; the zeroth return proof is unchanged.
